editorial: You’ll be drawn into a sun-kissed island where every guest hides a secret. The film mixes classic whodunit flair with a tech-savvy backdrop, letting mystery unfold on Facebook threads and kitchen tables alike. Joaquin Phoenix’s Benoit Blanc cuts through dialogue with a razor-sharp wit that turns even the quiet moments into stage directions. The plot’s second act elongates a bit, weighing down the momentum before the final reveal. If you relish a cerebral mystery peppered with satire, this will keep you on your toes.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
watchReasons: Joaquin Phoenix delivers a character-rich performance
a plot that slices through modern tech
